currentRoundInspection.scope: Three useful exterior pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM only;no bespoke survey sources or redistributed photographs.

pictures.observed: Inspected elevated west front: two square stone towers,octagonal open round-arched belfries,tapered stone pinnacled cones/crosses,central tall traceried facade and steep central clock gable,pointed portal/canopy and narrow flanking piers. Warm limestone surfaces;aged dark areas are not baked into the palette. Exact tracery,statues/clock numerals/crockets excluded or abstracted.

Inspected east-northeast choir: polygonal high choir with tall pointed windows and upper blind arcade/parapet,lower ambulatory and radiating small chapels,green-gray metal ledges and shallow chapel roofs,tall transept/eastern unfinished square flank tower. Several tiers of pointed windows carry recognition;sculpture and exact moldings excluded.

Inspected southern nave from cloister: tall upper pointed windows beneath parapet/pinnacles,dark steep roof,row of individual lower aisle gables/pointed windows,and a lower open pointed cloister arcade facing grass court. Mapped adjoining cloister ranges/chapter chapel are retained as estimated exterior masses;their full peripheral facades/functions are not independently pictured.
